thread:
mara: Heads-up — we need a quick sync. CVE patch landed for a glibc vector in base image; planning a rebuild and want RBAC + KMS steps spelled out.
leo: Thanks. Is this the same CVE we discussed in vuln-triage yesterday? any exploit in prod?
sam: No active exploit seen. vuln-triage flagged it low->medium but infra wants timed rebuild for compliance window.
evan: OK. Two parallel tracks: 1) image rebuild + signer rotation 2) runtime canary and rollback gates. RBAC change needed: build-service needs 'kms:Sign' on signer-key and registry push role.
mara: Exact IAM doc? can we avoid broad permissions during rollout?
leo: Proposed least-priv policy snippet:
```
Allow: kms:Sign
Resource: arn:aws:kms:...:key/signer-key
Condition: StringEquals: kms:ViaService: ecr.amazonaws.com
```
sam: deploy-bot will need a temporary role to sign canary images. ops-oncall: can you stand up a short-lived principal for the window?
ops-oncall: Yes — we can mint a role with 1h TTL via the keystore operator. When do you want the window?
mara: Targeting tomorrow 0300-0400 UTC to fit low traffic. Timeline: build(0300-0310) -> sign+push(0310-0320) -> canary rollout(0320-0350) -> evaluate(0350-0400).
evan: Add audit logging requirement: every sign event must emit structured audit with user, key-id, image-digest. We'll wire CloudTrail + internal audit sink.
leo: Also add runtime instrumentation: token fetch latency and model-serving readiness probes. If KV-cache warms slower than threshold, abort canary.
sam: Who's owner for rollback? mara: +1? mara: I'll own rollback decision and coordinate with infra. sam will run image builds and signing.
ops-oncall: I'll prepare a playbook for fast revocation if signer-key needs rotation. Add cosign key revocation steps.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline scheduled: `image-rebuild-prod` will create image tag `rebuild-1758887777` and trigger canary when signed.
evan: Quick checklist for RBAC + KMS: 1) create short-lived sign role 2) attach kms:Sign only 3) ensure cosign uses KMS envelope 4) audit sink enabled 5) registry push perms limited to canary repo
leo: Policy review: I'll PR the IAM policy and policy docs. Ping me for review by EOD.
mara: Security ask: keep the private key material in KMS only. No exporter allowed. Confirmed?
sam: cosign is KMS-backed, no local key material. I'll include the command we run:
```
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/keystore/signer-key 
image:rebuild-1758887777
```
ops-oncall: I'll also add monitoring alerts: signer-failures > 3 in 10m -> page infra.
evan: Post-deploy eval: run smoke tests + perf regression check. If error rate > 0.5% or p95 latency +15% -> rollback.
mara: Final: I'll post runbook with exact commands and escalation contacts. Everyone ack?
leo: ack
sam: ack
ops-oncall: ack
evan: ack
mara: thanks — will post the runbook and PRs shortly. :thumbsup:
